metadata.tactile_unit_vendor_claim: SDK header getFingerTactile/Detail says 0.1 N per count; not physically calibrated
metadata.taxel_mask_meaning: verified enabled/healthy taxels AND connected nonfault sample; all false until supplied
metadata.taxel_order: SDK return order; geometric mapping not yet verified
metadata.tcp_frame: each arm controller base; xyz(m)+rotation vector(rad), not shared world or palm
metadata.time_contract: hand SDK query begin/end and arm callback receipt on host monotonic clock
metadata.hand_observation_representation: temporary CAD clamp of model joints; raw SDK joint observations retained
metadata.frame_coupling: arm and finger targets share XR sequence/session/generation; per-SDK timing retained
metadata.operator_missing_hand_storage: zero-filled fields only where hand_tracking_valid is false; not a pose

manifest.control_tcp: left_palm/right_palm at source URDF palm-link origins; no legacy TCP sites
manifest.installation_source: source URDF calibrated bases and DH13 mounts; no manual CAD reconstruction
manifest.ik_collision_policy: source arm/sensor meshes: 0.05/0.08 m; hand vs table: 0/0.01 m; hand vs opposite arm/opposite hand: 0.01/0.04 m; same-hand meshes excluded including fingers, palm/flange/camera and own link1-6; same-side link7/sensor vs flange excluded; objects/cables/people not modeled

derivations.description: Byte-exact deletion of two legacy TCP site lines; all other XML bytes and source assets unchanged.

kinematic_model.hand_pose_source: actual SDK 16 logical joints, including passive observations; unobserved side not valid

timestamp_contract.timestamp_ns: host monotonic receive/sample-completion time; not hardware sample time
timestamp_contract.xr_timestamp_ms: Quest XR session clock; not directly comparable to host clock
timestamp_contract.synchronization: raw streams retained independently; equal array indices are not synchronization
